issues.title: [Phase 1 · M01] Define architecture, domain model, and API contracts

closureEvidence.body:
## Developer handoff — architecture complete

Delivered directly to `main` in commits [7ba5af5](https://github.com/arkinara/modern-pos/commit/7ba5af549f11a921aa0dbe2b3c1c06255960ec3c) and [c12c418](https://github.com/arkinara/modern-pos/commit/c12c418d7d72fd3d4a8d376d673ee9925956062a).

Start with [HANDOFF.md](https://github.com/arkinara/modern-pos/blob/main/HANDOFF.md), then [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/arkinara/modern-pos/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md) and [API.openapi.json](https://github.com/arkinara/modern-pos/blob/main/API.openapi.json). The contract defines 40 operations / 47 schemas. The baseline covers business/outlet isolation, recipe-based menu consumption, immutable sale snapshots, integer money, decimal stock, atomic stock/sale completion, idempotent recovery, reversals and independent printing.

**Next developer:** pick up #3 (scaffolding), then #4, #6 and #7. Preserve the sale/stock transaction boundary; do not deduct stock through an after-sale webhook. Use the same OpenAPI contract for Flutter and Next.js clients. Run `node verify-foundation.cjs` for the supplied structural/script/contrast checks; full API/database/concurrency tests still belong to implementation.

The design prototype is available at https://arkinara.github.io/modern-pos/prototype.html. #2 remains In QA for owner style approval; backend scaffolding can proceed. No production app, real payment integration or physical printer support is claimed by this design delivery.

issues.title: [Phase 1 · M02] Create minimalist design system and core flow prototypes

closureEvidence.body:
## Developer handoff — design package ready for owner review

Committed directly to `main`: [7ba5af5](https://github.com/arkinara/modern-pos/commit/7ba5af549f11a921aa0dbe2b3c1c06255960ec3c), with verification/touch-target refinements in [c12c418](https://github.com/arkinara/modern-pos/commit/c12c418d7d72fd3d4a8d376d673ee9925956062a).

**Review the interactive prototype:** https://arkinara.github.io/modern-pos/prototype.html

The proposed style uses warm neutral surfaces, a deep teal accent, restrained borders, clear typography and generous touch targets. Explore Menu editing, Stock adjustments, the Flutter cashier/cart, cash/manual checkout, Reports/date/CSV, and simulated printer setup/failure. Review-only selectors expose loading/empty/error/offline states. All data is synthetic and resets on reload.

[DESIGN_SYSTEM.md](https://github.com/arkinara/modern-pos/blob/main/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md) defines tokens, icons, responsive layouts, components, keyboard/focus and error states. [design-tokens.json](https://github.com/arkinara/modern-pos/blob/main/design-tokens.json) is the machine-readable baseline. [HANDOFF.md](https://github.com/arkinara/modern-pos/blob/main/HANDOFF.md) records the implementation order and verification evidence.

Verified the sale→stock→report path, insufficient cash and negative-stock validation, menu edit with historical receipt snapshots, printer failure/recovery, date filtering/CSV export, Ctrl+K/Escape, and all five screen layouts at 320/1024/1440px without horizontal page overflow. Seven core text-contrast pairs pass. This is not a full accessibility audit or native Flutter/device test.

**Status: In QA, left open for owner visual approval.** Please review palette, spacing/density, type, product tiles, navigation and phone layout. Implementation developers should start #3 from the completed architecture #1; hold style-dependent UI work under #5/#11 until owner feedback is resolved. The prototype is a design reference, not production transaction or printer code.

## UI/UX Pro Max refinement ready for review

Refined directly on `main`, starting with [97dc9ca](https://github.com/arkinara/modern-pos/commit/97dc9cad95816d5cd33eff1913eac1d46101ce78) and finalized in /arkinara/modern-pos/commit/ad20928ad03c48e1ff2f2e0d86d8688562815d6a.

**Live review:** https://arkinara.github.io/modern-pos/prototype.html

Applied the skill’s minimal/Swiss operational UI guidance while retaining the warm neutral/deep teal palette. Changes include official locally embedded Lucide icons, clearer 15–16px working typography, stronger totals and field boundaries, less repetitive cart actions, a mobile bottom navigation/order-total dock, accessible 200% text reflow, browser Back support, focus retention after quantity changes, and reduced-motion rules. Review controls are now inside a native disclosure.

Verification: all five screens at 320×812, 375×812, 812×375 landscape, 1024×768 and 1440×1000 have no horizontal page overflow. The phone cashier reflows to one column at 200% text. Focus remains on the quantity action; browser Back preserves the cart; a demo Rp80,000 sale from Rp100,000 cash gives Rp20,000 change and updates Reports. Core text contrast checks pass; field/control boundaries measure 3.62:1 on white.

[UX_REFINEMENT.md](https://github.com/arkinara/modern-pos/blob/main/UX_REFINEMENT.md) documents the skill queries, adopted/rejected recommendations and bounded evidence. [DESIGN_SYSTEM.md](https://github.com/arkinara/modern-pos/blob/main/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md), tokens and [HANDOFF.md](https://github.com/arkinara/modern-pos/blob/main/HANDOFF.md) are updated. Run `node verify-foundation.cjs` for reproducible structural/script/contrast checks.

Returned this ticket to **In QA** and left it open for the owner’s visual approval. Native Flutter accessibility/device testing and a full accessibility audit are still implementation work; this is a light-only browser prototype with synthetic data.
